testId: testim-migrated/tests/admin/sales-rep/sales-rep-management.spec.ts > Admin - Sales Rep > Z10-TC-23084 sales rep store assignment persists after save and after a store change

scenario.summary: A sales rep assigned to store A is saved without changes and stays on store A (not reset to All Stores); then the admin changes the assignment to store B, saves and closes, and the sales rep stays on store B.
steps: Open the sales rep's (@rep.userName) management page; check it is assigned to store A (@storeA.name).
Click Save without changes; re-open the management page; the assignment is still store A, not All Stores.
Change the store assignment to store B (@storeB.name); click Save and Close.
Re-open the management page; the assignment is store B.
stateChanges: The sales rep's store assignment is changed from store A to store B (the sales rep is deleted at teardown).
assertions: After a no-change save the assignment is store A and All Stores is unchecked
After the change the assignment is store B
evidence: Story Z10-28590 (Stabilize Sales Rep Workflow), data-needs analysis work/stories/Z10-28590/analysis.md section 2 and answers in section 6.
FSD 'Manage an Existing Sales Rep': the system keeps the original store configuration and does not reset to All Stores.
The test case cites bug Z10-28456 (Done): a failure is a regression (analysis answer 5).
Store MaxwellsHardware: the store the migrated suites run on (store A).
Store B: STORE_WEBSTORE_ACTIVE with exceptPortalId = @storeA.portalId and no store (optional params from change proposal 7a, analysis.md; pending approval): any other active webstore.
Admin session: the suite's saved admin session (admin.setup.ts), a credential, not a need.
